correctness.rationale: Two independent methods exhaust all 32768 edge subsets and agree on 342 simplices including empty. Two complete 168-pair Morse matchings each pass a 1020-arrow Hasse acyclicity check and leave one vertex, two triangles and two tetrahedra. The signed integer gradient reduction computes a zero 2-by-2 Morse differential in both orders. Because the 2-skeleton of the Morse CW model is S2∨S2 and pi2 is Z², both 3-cell attachments are nullhomotopic, proving the integral mixed sphere wedge. Integral chain-flow representatives establish the D5×C2 matrices; a second matching and signed simplicial Lefschetz calculation cross-check characters. Independent mod-two ranks are (14,61,82,11). These checks are replayable from the included verifier.

value.rationale: A natural five-sided circular ladder is the smallest nontriangular odd prism and a canonical vertex-transitive cubic graph. A relevant primary paper explicitly proposes investigating ordinary matching complexes of circular ladders. The result distinguishes ordinary topology (two 2-spheres plus two 3-spheres) from the known contractible perfect-matching subcomplex and describes the non-obvious trivial fivefold rotation action together with distinct reflection and layer-swap characters. This supplies a complete symmetry-sensitive exact case, not a trivial Euler-characteristic recomputation or an arbitrary unlabeled graph.
